previous_style_handoff.scope: Final Cleanup translation/context queue (569 entries). The previous Japanese candidate is a starting point only; nothing is pre-approved. Return the contract below. Do not run ROM tools.
language_rules: Kana only: hiragana, katakana, and the Japanese-charmap symbols below. No kanji.

Natural game Japanese in the manner of the main Pokémon series; keep the existing wakachigaki baseline for prose, but do not put spaces inside proper names, place names, mission titles or short UI labels.
Keep the meaning, event conditions, numbers, item/mission/battle conditions and foreshadowing unchanged. Never add or remove information to make a line sound nicer.
Do not state an official Japanese name from memory. Use an approved glossary term, or mark the entry needs_context when a name is not approved.
Runtime width that is merely unverified must not stop the translation. Write natural, compact Japanese; Codex checks technical fit afterwards. Never cut meaning to save width.

charmap_probe.note: Probed against the Japanese PCS codec. ASCII letters and digits are allowed; Latin text inside a Japanese string is handled by the controlfix page switch, not by you.

speaker_rules.PROVEN: A trainer ID or object binding only. Keep the same speaker's lines consistent and in the same batch. It is not a canon identity, a name reading, a gender or an age.
speaker_rules.CONFIRMED_VOICE: An approved profile is attached (1 profile overall). Follow it.
speaker_rules.PROVISIONAL_VOICE: Reference only. Do not force it as the person's own voice.
speaker_rules.NEUTRAL_ONLY_or_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Use a natural neutral tone that follows the English attitude.
speaker_rules.PLAUSIBLE: A candidate from object-script proximity. State it as a candidate; never treat entries as the same person.
speaker_rules.UNKNOWN: Reflect the English attitude (cheerful, angry, formal, sarcastic, surprised, disappointed). No invented first person, gendered ending, dialect or old-age speech.
speaker_rules.NON_DIALOGUE: No NPC voice profile. Use the register of the interface or message type.
speaker_rules.first_and_second_person: Omit pronouns unless the English or a proven profile requires one. 'きみ' for the player is a convention, not a speaker trait.

previous_style_handoff.official_character_rule: No official canon character is proven (0). A shared name is not identity. Do not claim to reproduce an original Japanese voice: the identity, the source game and a Japanese-version voice reference are all missing.
glossary_rules: Use `approved_glossary_terms` only for the exact entry (scope and entry_ids are given; global_replace is false for every Phase 6C term).
Never substitute by substring. Ace is not Aerial Ace; Cut, Strength and Fighting rejected as terms stay ordinary words.
`unresolved_glossary_warnings` are warnings: do not translate that term by guess; choose needs_context if the line depends on it.
`glossary_matcher_hits` lists matches of the merged 292-term glossary and is informational.

dangerous_controls: colors, quote, button, alignment and pause tokens
control_rules.technical_hold: If natural Japanese needs a word order that crosses a source control, do not move the control: return status needs_technical_fit and explain.

previous_style_handoff.buffer_rule: Keep buffer tokens in source order. Unknown or caller-dependent buffers (buffer1-3, battle codes 00/01/2A/36/38) are never guessed: return needs_context. Engine-defined name/move/ability battle codes and [player]/[rival] are typed.

fa_contract.claude_returns: one reviewed_japanese per unit in source order; reviewed_japanese at entry level stays empty
fa_contract.never: place, remove, move, merge or split FA/FE/FB; invent a segment boundary
fa_contract.hold: needs_technical_fit when the meaning cannot be carried inside the segments

per_entry.reviewed_japanese: non-FA entries; '' for hold or FA
per_entry.segments: FA entries: [{segment_index, source, reviewed_japanese, protected_tokens, after_control}]
per_entry.speaker_notes: what evidence was used; 'unknown' stays unknown

known_bad_patterns: speaker invented from a name or pointer proximity
first person or gendered ending added without evidence
FA appended or moved by character index
buffer guessed from the English sentence
meaning changed to sound more natural
proper noun changed without a glossary decision

current_rules: Kana-only. Natural Pokemon-style Japanese; preserve meaning, conditions, numbers and foreshadowing.
Use verified official names and exact scoped glossary hits only. No memory-only name or scope expansion.
Do not unnecessarily add first/second person. Follow the English attitude, not an invented character.
PROVEN speaker identity is NOT CONFIRMED_VOICE; no canon or source-game identity from a shared name.
Use an attached CONFIRMED_VOICE only as approved; other profiles are provisional or neutral guidance.
Do not guess unknown buffer values or writers. Player/rival field semantics do not prove width/page safety; battle FD codec aliases do not prove field-name semantics.
Preserve FE/FA/FB/FC/FD and protected tokens. No introduced page switches; controlfix owns Japanese/Latin.
FA rows return one unit per original segment, same control order. Do not invent/merge boundaries.
Important information crossing FA/FB needs separate semantic/reveal review; natural grammar alone is insufficient.
Translation readiness is NOT injection approval. Never truncate meaning to fit unproved width or slot.
Prior candidate/review is read-only evidence, not automatically approved. Preserve original confidence and holds.
Static path context is not runtime chronology. No map/address proximity speaker or scene inference.

per_entry.reviewed_japanese: non-FA entries; '' for hold or FA
per_entry.segments: FA entries: [{segment_index, source, reviewed_japanese, protected_tokens, after_control}]
per_entry.speaker_notes: what evidence was used; 'unknown' stays unknown

attached_profile_policy: Only profiles already linked to actual Batch 01 IDs; zero invented matches
